notes: Three taḥwīl branches, each started by «ح» or a new «وحدثنا»: three groups.
«كلهم عن الحكم، عن عبد الرحمن بن أبي ليلى، عن عبد الله بن عكيم» is written once after the last «ح» and belongs to every branch: the shared tail (rule 3).
«أبو بكر» stands three times in the text: the first branch is occurrence 1, the third is occurrence 3 (the second is «أبو بكر بن أبي شيبة»).
